name: Cadaverous Menagerie
related_quests: Casting the Bones: Investigate a necromancer cult searching for a long-dead Dragon.
Pledge: Fang Lair: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Fang Lair.
summary: The Cadaverous Menagerie consists of a Cadaverous Bear, Guar, and Senche-Tiger which have been reanimated and can be found within Fang Lair. They are the second boss of the dungeon.
